other_conditions: Family should not have benefited from existing housing schemes like PMAY-R, Indira Awas Yojana, or Birsa Awas Yojana.
Families living in kutcha houses or without permanent housing are eligible.
Eligibility category noted in source: PVTG
Eligibility category noted in source: victims of natural calamities
Eligibility category noted in source: released bonded laborers
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 per beneficiary for house construction and up to 95 days of unskilled labour wages under MGNREGA.
